You notice a lever on the wall hidden in the shadows.\nIt has a small circle engraved on it.\nDo you move the lever?
es: Notas una palanca en la pared, oculta entre las sombras.\nTiene un pequeño círculo grabado.\n¿Mueves la palanca?
fr: Vous remarquez un levier sur le mur, caché dans l’ombre.\nIl porte un petit cercle gravé.\nBougez-vous le levier ?

en: \nPERCEPTION: in fact, the circle looks like some kind of skull.
es: \nPERCEPCIÓN: en realidad, el círculo parece una especie de calavera.
fr: \nPERCEPTION : en fait, le cercle ressemble à une sorte de crâne.

en: It was a trap!\nA secret trapdoor opens in the ceiling and a stone falls on your head.\nYour life is reduced to half a heart.
es: ¡Era una trampa!\nSe abre una trampilla secreta en el techo y una piedra cae sobre tu cabeza.\nTu vida se reduce a medio corazón.
fr: C’était un piège !\nUne trappe secrète s’ouvre au plafond et une pierre tombe sur votre tête.\nVotre vie est réduite à un demi-cœur.

en: You feel that something strange is happening with the lighting of the environment, as if the shadows were not where they should be.\nDo you investigate the area?
\nPERCEPTION: actually, it seems that something is bending the light above your head, on a ledge.
You discover a small invisible chest on a shelf, which contains a single gold coin. Gold coins are rare, so you decide to keep it with care. It could be useful later!

You notice a loose tile in the corner of the hallway that looks like a switch.\nUnder normal circumstances you would think it's a trap, but it's strange that it's not right in the middle of the path.\nDo you press it?
\nPERCEPTION: the floor sounds hollow in this area.
The floor opens and you fall to the next level!\nYour life is reduced to half a heart.

You find a sword and a bracelet among some cobwebs. If these objects belonged to a person, not even the bones are left.\nThe sword is in very bad shape, but the bracelet seems sturdy and in perfect condition.\nDo you take it?
\nPERCEPTION: the webs could be dangerous, but you think you will be able to retrieve the item without touching them.
With great care, you manage to recover the bracelet without incident. DEF +0.5
You come across a fountain, its water glowing with a faint, unnatural red light.\nAn inscription reads: "Immerse an object to give it power".\nDo you give it a try?
\nPERCEPTION: even in the depths of this dungeon, it seems strange to you that there is no trace of life around a water source.
You don't want to risk losing something essential for survival, so you start by dipping your old, but trusty, gauntlets.\nThey're ruined! DEF -0.5
You notice a lever on the wall hidden in the shadows.\nIt has a small X engraved on it.\nDo you move the lever?
\nPERCEPTION: in fact, the X looks like a crossed fork and knife.

A secret compartment opens in the wall. Under the light of a candelabra, the most wonderful food awaits you. What a delicious surprise!\nYou feel better than ever, and you regain all your life plus an extra heart.
You come across a fountain, its water glowing with a faint, unnatural blue light.\nAn inscription reads: "Immerse an object to give it power".\nDo you give it a try?
\nPERCEPTION: silver flowers grow beside the water.

You don't want to risk losing something essential for survival, so you start by dipping your old, but trusty, gauntlets.\nThey've been enchanted! Magic ATK +0.5\nAfter that, the water loses its shine.

In a room full of candles you find a book on a lectern.\nIt tells the story of a long-haired warrior who one day finds a spell capable of enchanting capes. You don't know what happens next, because the last pages are half burned.\nDo you pronounce the incantation?
\nPERCEPTION: judging by the pictures, the warrior's cloak is exactly like your invisibility cloak. There is no discernible difference.
After casting the spell, your invisibility cloak loses its power. It seems that you have reversed the original enchantment! You speak the magic words again, even backwards, but nothing happens.
You find a dusty cloth that seems to be hiding something human-sized.\nDo you remove it to see what's underneath?
\nPERCEPTION: you feel an evil aura.
After removing the fabric, you discover a picture stand with an old painting of yourself, but no face.\nThis vision deeply disturbs you. Perception -1

You meet a small, suspicious-looking humanoid.
He says: "I'll sell you the helmet I found for %s gold coins".
He doesn't seem to be carrying the item with him, but perhaps it is hidden somewhere.
Do you give him the coins you have?
\nPERCEPTION: you notice that he has looked out of the corner of his eye at some vines.
The little humanoid takes the money and moves some vines, revealing a hole in the wall, from which he pulls out the helmet.\nAfter giving it to you, he says: "No refunds!"
You don't have enough money to make the purchase!

You find a room full of statues in grotesque poses.
The room, rather large, seems even more so because one of the walls is a mirror.
After examining the sculptures, you realize that each of them is missing an object.
Voices echo in your head: "You will never be able to leave this cursed maze, unless you restore the stolen treasures. Give them to us, and we will give you what you seek".
Do you trust the voices and put the inventory items you have in place?
\nPERCEPTION: one of the voices sounds familiar and comforting.

After putting the last of the items in place, you are startled to see that... your reflection has disappeared from the mirror!
However, you soon realize the truth: the mirror is no longer there and what looks like a reflection is a completely identical adjacent room.
Upon inspecting this new room, you discover a treasure chest hidden behind one of the statues, which contains a gem... but not just any gem!
You have found the lost family gemstone! Your twin sister can finally rest in peace.
Press continue to start a new game.
You put the items you have in place, but nothing happens.\nIt seems you are missing %s treasures.
